entities.name: MOM-protected substrate
observations: Contains an aryl methoxymethyl (MOM) ether represented by Ar-O-CH2-OCH3.
The fused-ring scaffold, ketone, aldehyde, and alkyl substituents are retained in the matched reaction.

entities.name: Phenolic product
observations: The aryl MOM ether is converted to a free phenol; other major functional groups remain unchanged.

entities.name: ORD ord-5e095afd3cf54d9699b1d0db2754a4f0
observations: Exact matching reaction record for acid-promoted cleavage of an aryl MOM ether.
Recorded conditions/components include methanol, ethyl acetate, and hydrochloric acid/chloride representation.

entities.name: Acidic MOM deprotection
observations: Methanolic acidic conditions promote cleavage of Ar-O-CH2-OCH3 to Ar-OH.
Ethyl acetate is a solvent/workup component rather than an incorporated reactant.
